messages.subject_clean: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1077860: src:r-cran-tmb: fails to migrate to testing for too long: triggers autopkgtest issues
messages.body_plain:
Source: r-cran-tmb
Version: 1.9.11-2
Severity: serious
Control: close -1 1.9.13-1
Tags: sid trixie
User: release.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: out-of-sync

Dear maintainer(s),

The Release Team considers packages that are out-of-sync between testing 
and unstable for more than 30 days as having a Release Critical bug in 
testing [1]. Your package src:r-cran-tmb has been trying to migrate for 
32 days [2]. Hence, I am filing this bug. The version in unstable causes 
autopkgtest failure in r-cran-glmmtmb.

If a package is out of sync between unstable and testing for a longer 
period, this usually means that bugs in the package in testing cannot be 
fixed via unstable. Additionally, blocked packages can have impact on 
other packages, which makes preparing for the release more difficult. 
Finally, it often exposes issues with the package and/or
its (reverse-)dependencies. We expect maintainers to fix issues that 
hamper the migration of their package in a timely manner.

This bug will trigger auto-removal when appropriate. As with all new 
bugs, there will be at least 30 days before the package is auto-removed.

I have immediately closed this bug with the version in unstable, so if 
that version or a later version migrates, this bug will no longer affect 
testing. I have also tagged this bug to only affect sid and trixie, so 
it doesn't affect (old-)stable.

If you believe your package is unable to migrate to testing due to 
issues beyond your control, don't hesitate to contact the Release Team.

Paul

[1] https://lists.debian.org/debian-devel-announce/2023/06/msg00001.html
[2] https://qa.debian.org/excuses.php?package=r-cran-tmb

messages.body_plain:
Package: ftp.debian.org
Severity: normal
X-Debbugs-Cc: r-bioc-ebseq at packages.debian.org, debian-r at lists.debian.org, crusoe at debian.org
Control: affects -1 + src:r-bioc-ebseq
User: ftp.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: remove

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the first such removal request, for r-bioc-ebseq. According to dak there should be no issue removing the 32-bit architecture versions of this binary package:

$ ssh mirror.ftp-master.debian.org "dak rm --architecture=armel,armhf,i386 --no-arch-all-rdeps --binary-only --partial --rdep-check --no-action r-bioc-ebseq"
Will remove the following packages from unstable:

r-bioc-ebseq |    2.0.0-1 | armel, armhf, i386

Maintainer: Debian R Packages Maintainers <r-pkg-team at alioth-lists.debian.net>

------------------- Reason -------------------

----------------------------------------------

Checking reverse dependencies...
No dependency problem found.

---

Thanks!

-- 
Michael R. Crusoe

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the third such removal request, this time for r-bioc-eir . According to dak there should be no issue removing the 32-bit architecture versions of this binary package:

Will remove the following packages from unstable:

messages.subject: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1078921: r-cran-hdf5r: FTBFS against HDF5 1.14
messages.body_plain:
Source: r-cran-hdf5r
Version: 1.3.9+dfsg-1
Severity: important

-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

Hi,

The r-cran-hdf5r package fails to build from source in a test rebuild against
hdf5 1.14 currently in experimental:

gcc -I"/usr/share/R/include" -DNDEBUG -I/usr/include/hdf5/serial  -I/usr/include/hdf5/serial     -D__USE_MINGW_ANSI_STDIO -DH5_USE_110_API -fpic  -g -O2 -ffile-prefix-map=/build/reproducible-path/r-base-4.4.1=. 
- -fstack-protector-strong -fstack-clash-protection -Wformat -Werror=format-security -fcf-protection -Wdate-time -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2  -c convert.c -o convert.o
convert.c: In function ?R_reorder?:
convert.c:1586:24: error: initialization of ?hsize_t *? {aka ?long unsigned int *?} from incompatible pointer type ?long long unsigned int *? [-Wincompatible-pointer-types]
 1586 |   hsize_t* new_order = (unsigned long long *) VOIDPTR(R_helper);
      |                        ^
make[1]: *** [/usr/lib/R/etc/Makeconf:195: convert.o] Error 1


The patch below fixes the issue:

Index: r-cran-hdf5r-1.3.9+dfsg/src/convert.c
===================================================================
- --- r-cran-hdf5r-1.3.9+dfsg.orig/src/convert.c
+++ r-cran-hdf5r-1.3.9+dfsg/src/convert.c
@@ -1583,7 +1583,7 @@ SEXP R_reorder(SEXP R_src, SEXP R_num_ro
   hsize_t item_size = SEXP_to_longlong(R_item_size, 0);
 
   SEXP R_helper = PROTECT(RToH5(R_new_order, H5T_NATIVE_ULLONG, num_rows));
- -  hsize_t* new_order = (unsigned long long *) VOIDPTR(R_helper);
+  hsize_t* new_order = (hsize_t *) VOIDPTR(R_helper);
   
   SEXP R_dst = PROTECT(duplicate(R_src));
   reorder(VOIDPTR(R_dst), VOIDPTR(R_src), num_rows, num_cols, item_size, new_order);


Best,
_g.

messages.subject_clean: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1078923: RM: r-bioc-monocle [armel armhf i386] -- ROM; Upstream no longer supports 32-bit systems
messages.body_plain:
Package: ftp.debian.org
Severity: normal
X-Debbugs-Cc: r-bioc-monocle at packages.debian.org, debian-r at lists.debian.org, crusoe at debian.org
Control: affects -1 + src:r-bioc-monocle
User: ftp.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: remove

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the seventh such removal request, this time for r-bioc-monocle. According to dak there should be no issue removing the 32-bit architecture versions of this binary package:

$ ssh mirror.ftp-master.debian.org "dak rm --architecture=armel,armhf,i386 --no-arch-all-rdeps --binary-only --partial --rdep-check --no-action r-bioc-monocle"
Will remove the following packages from unstable:

r-bioc-monocle |   2.30.0-1 | armel, armhf, i386

Maintainer: Debian R Packages Maintainers <r-pkg-team at alioth-lists.debian.net>

------------------- Reason -------------------

----------------------------------------------

Checking reverse dependencies...
No dependency problem found.

---

Thanks!

[0] https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00033.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00035.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00045.html

-- 
Michael R. Crusoe

messages.body_plain:
Package: ftp.debian.org
Severity: normal
X-Debbugs-Cc: r-bioc-destiny at packages.debian.org, debian-r at lists.debian.org, crusoe at debian.org
Control: affects -1 + src:r-bioc-destiny
User: ftp.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: remove

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the eighth such removal request, this time for r-bioc-destiny. According to dak there should be no issue removing the 32-bit architecture versions of this binary package:

$ ssh mirror.ftp-master.debian.org "dak rm --architecture=armel,armhf,i386 --no-arch-all-rdeps --binary-only --partial --rdep-check --no-action r-bioc-destiny"
Will remove the following packages from unstable:

r-bioc-destiny |   3.16.0-1 | armel, armhf, i386

Maintainer: Debian R Packages Maintainers <r-pkg-team at alioth-lists.debian.net>

------------------- Reason -------------------

----------------------------------------------

Checking reverse dependencies...
No dependency problem found.

---

Thanks!

[0] https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00033.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00035.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00045.html

-- 
Michael R. Crusoe

messages.subject_clean: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1078961: RM: r-bioc-scran [armel armhf i386] -- ROM; Upstream no longer supports 32-bit systems
messages.body_plain:
Package: ftp.debian.org
Severity: normal
X-Debbugs-Cc: r-bioc-scran at packages.debian.org, debian-r at lists.debian.org, crusoe at debian.org
Control: affects -1 + src:r-bioc-scran
User: ftp.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: remove

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the 10th such removal request, this time for r-bioc-scran. According to dak there should be no issue removing the 32-bit architecture versions of this binary package:

$ ssh mirror.ftp-master.debian.org "dak rm --architecture=armel,armhf,i386 --no-arch-all-rdeps --binary-only --partial --rdep-check --no-action r-bioc-scran"
Will remove the following packages from unstable:

r-bioc-scran | 1.30.2+dfsg-1 | armel, armhf, i386

Maintainer: Debian R Packages Maintainers <r-pkg-team at alioth-lists.debian.net>

------------------- Reason -------------------

----------------------------------------------

Checking reverse dependencies...
No dependency problem found.

---

Thanks!

-- 
Michael R. Crusoe

messages.subject_clean: [R-pkg-team] Bug#1078974: RM: r-bioc-affxparser [armel armhf i386] -- ROM; Upstream no longer supports 32-bit systems
messages.body_plain:
Package: ftp.debian.org
Severity: normal
X-Debbugs-Cc: r-bioc-affxparser at packages.debian.org, debian-r at lists.debian.org, crusoe at debian.org
Control: affects -1 + src:r-bioc-affxparser
Control: block -1 by 1078972
Tags: moreinfo
User: ftp.debian.org at packages.debian.org
Usertags: remove

Dear FTP Team,

As part of the Bioconductor 3.19 transition, the Debian R team agreed [0] to remove builds for 32-bit architectures (where possible) in line with upstream's cessation of support for 32-bit systems.

Here is the 19th such removal request, this time for r-bioc-affxparser. `dak` does point out that "r-bioc-oligo" needs handling first. Once the 32-binaries for r-bioc-oligo are removed then I think removing the 32-bit builds of r-bioc-affxparser from unstable will not cause any problems:

$ ssh mirror.ftp-master.debian.org "dak rm --architecture=armel,armhf,i386 --no-arch-all-rdeps --binary-only --partial --rdep-check --no-action r-bioc-affxparser"
Will remove the following packages from unstable:

r-bioc-affxparser |   1.74.0-1 | armel, armhf, i386

Maintainer: Debian R Packages Maintainers <r-pkg-team at alioth-lists.debian.net>

------------------- Reason -------------------

----------------------------------------------

Checking reverse dependencies...
# Broken Depends:
r-bioc-oligo: r-bioc-oligo

# Broken Build-Depends:
r-bioc-oligo: r-bioc-affxparser (1.76.0 >=)

Dependency problem found.

---

Thanks!

[0] https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00033.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00035.html https://lists.debian.org/debian-r/2024/07/msg00045.html

-- 
Michael R. Crusoe
